title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Player Exodus
items.text: Reports indicate many LIV golfers may not return despite new funding, even as Bryson DeChambeau remains publicly optimistic.

items.headline: FedExCup Playoffs Field Set
items.text: Rookie Jackson Koivun is the last player to qualify for this week's FedEx St. Jude Championship playoff field.

items.headline: McIlroy vs. Scheffler Earnings
items.text: Rory McIlroy leads Scottie Scheffler by less than $200,000 in career PGA Tour earnings as they chase Tiger Woods's record.
